question: Should AI Council implement the corrected usefulness-measurement MVP now?

knownConsiderations.claim: Forecast accuracy alone cannot measure novel useful findings.
The current append-only ledger is a tested base for additive capture.
Historical reconstructed baselines cannot support prospective novelty claims.
Per-cell novelty and confidently-wrong adjudication was noisy.
Recent councils are serially dependent within a few decision families.
The evidence tree lacks a project-owned off-host backup path.
Adding seats before finding capture creates more unscoreable output.
Eligibility, activation, first-ten ordering, and handling-time clocks must be mechanical.
V1 parsing must remain unchanged while V2 uses explicit dispatch and exact keys.
Artifact references need content addressing, path containment, no-follow reads, and re-verification.
Findings and dispositions need one frozen append-only state machine.
Brier is descriptive forecast accuracy, not a calibration proof.
Finding co-occurrence measures overlap, not causal redundancy or replaceability.
Initiation identity must be durably appended before preparation so pre-attempt crashes cannot disappear.
Known-bad sealed captures need a minimal append-only invalidation event.
Missing or invalid timing must deterministically fail the cohort time bar.
A submitted seat needs atomic findings or a seat-originated structured no-findings declaration.
Any plausible pathway from council output to an outcome requires intervention-sensitive classification.
Every seat-visible prompt must literally contain the same commit, Git blob, and SHA-256 bindings.

mindChangers.claim: Mixed V1 and V2 ledgers cannot be parsed without weakening strict failure behavior.
The artifact protocol requires secrets, hidden reasoning, or irrelevant raw tool output.
A timed structured rehearsal exceeds three minutes of active handling.
Intervention-sensitive or legacy outcomes can enter headline Brier output.
The evidence snapshot cannot be independently restored and verified.
Parallel slices cannot integrate without weakening append-only guarantees.
Fault injection can create an unobserved initiation or a complete dangling reference.

implementationDecision: Proceed only after a third uniformly bound council has no BLOCK; keep rollout capture-only.
